text:
marie: heads-up to eng-ml: prepping serving rollout for zeta-ext-110k (v1). weights uploaded, tokenizer changes may be required. requesting quick kv / mem sanity check before we schedule dedicated ramp. details below.

marie: weights path:
```
s3://redwood-weights/zeta-ext-110k/v1/
  - model_weights.pt
  - tokenizer.json
  - config.json
sha256: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e
```

vikram: got it. can you paste the config.json snippet (max_context, kv_cache_format, quant)? also please attach model_size (GB).

marie: config snippet:
```
{
  "max_context": 110000,
  "kv_cache_format": "packed-v1",
  "quant": "q4_k",
  "num_layers": 80,
  "hidden_size": 12288
}
model_size_bytes: 78_000_000_000
```

sasha: quick tokenizer note: older tokenizer.json we used for zeta-70b added an extra BOS byte on some merged docs -> duplicated start token when concatenating chunks. diff shows new tokenizer has explicit "bos_token": "<s>" and normalization tweak. run this quick test: `python tests/tokenizer_test.py --model zeta-ext-110k` to validate edgecases.

taylor: about kv cache layout: packed-v1 is fine but we should validate sharding behavior for very long seqs. what production seq_len distribution are we expecting? 110k is huge; need to confirm OOM risk on single GPU vs sharded across 2+ devices.

chen: rough memory back-of-envelope for q4_k 70B on our baseline A100-80: kv cache ~0.11 GB per 10k tokens per direction * layers factor -> i ran a quick sim. i'll run the exact script now: `./scripts/kv_mem_estimate.py --model zeta-ext-110k --seq 110000 --quant q4_k`

chen: paste of simulate output:
```
ESTIMATE SUMMARY (q4_k, seq=110000, batch=1):
  KV cache: 12.1 GB
  Activations (peak): 8.7 GB
  Model weights (device): 78.0 GB (q4_k)
  Overheads (cuda, runtime): 2.6 GB
  ESTIMATED PEAK TOTAL: ~101.4 GB
STATUS: Exceeds single A100-80 (80GB) by ~21GB.
RECOMMENDATION: enable kv_sharding across 2 GPUs OR fall back to 32k-variant for single-GPU canary. Also consider sharded-packed-v2 format.
```

marie: thanks @chen. can you run a mock canary with `--shard-kv 2 --batch 1` and paste runtime mem trace? also add the hash to the weights manifest. i'll open PR for onboarding checklist and canary policy.

chen: running now, will post traces in a follow-up thread. preliminary run with `--shard-kv 2` reports peak ~59GB on each device, total ~118GB across two devices, overheads smaller. suggests 2-way sharding should be safe for canary.

vikram: we should add an automatic fallback policy in router: if mem_error OR device_free < 10GB then route to zeta-ext-32k (same family, shorter ctx) and emit warning metric. @marie can you add to rollout config?

marie: yep i'll add fallback rule: route_policy.fallback = ["zeta-ext-32k"], start rate=1req/s, canary=5% traffic for 24h, healthchecks on latency <=2s and mem_errors==0. linking PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/3421

deploy-bot: model-upload-complete: zeta-ext-110k v1 -> staging cluster (job-id: 0xabc123). artifacts verified.

marie: excellent. blockers: tokenization test and chen's mem trace. marking status: blocked->in-review until traces posted. thanks all :thumbsup:

sasha: i'll run tokenizer_test and post results in thread within the hour.

vikram: once tests green, schedule dedicated ramp for next week. will coordinate with eng-sre for capacity.

marie: sounds good. closing thread for now, will update when chen posts trace and sasha confirms tokenizer.
